dropped.item: The replacement battery will be sent at no cost (explicit 'free' statement removed; only implied by the warranty)
'That's not the experience we want you to have' (acknowledgment that the failure falls short of the company's standard)

changed.item: The replacement and tracking email are now promised by the individual agent ('I will send', 'I will email') rather than by the company ('we will send', 'we'll email')

'Your bike is covered by our 2-year warranty' became 'comes with a two year warranty', a statement about the product rather than an explicit confirmation that this claim is covered (coverage is still implied by 'so I will send')
